scope: Reading-only source index and checksum verification through production Worker and Client
cases: Reference and candidate bytes are verified through the actual Worker and Client
A historical checksum can verify a candidate without an existing reference file
Reference corruption is detected from bytes before any API request
A stale reference identity is rejected before any API request
Same-size same-geometry candidate content changes are rejected and cleaned
Reference replacement during acquisition invalidates an otherwise matching candidate
Missing nonregular linked and outside-root references never reach the API
An existing own partial can be cleared and retried at the same assigned path
Candidates cannot alias references through a path or a hard link
Candidate paths reject outside roots and symbolic links without touching their targets
Reference and candidate byte limits and storage reserve remain enforced
Acquisition and container errors remove only the assigned candidate
Source index obtains fresh free and owned access before requesting an index
Unavailable locked unknown and expired access stop before an index request
Catalog identity mismatches and missing chapters stop before an index request
Source index API errors propagate without an extra request
